notes.title: 🏝️ Free "Basto" region update!! 🏝️
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/ebd8c8aa52bb01e9fb27993fc4c7e1bb79a14fde.png
Free Major Content Update!
It's already been a whole year since TOEM's release and wowee what a journey it's been! 

We've been overjoyed seeing players laugh at our dumb jokes, squeal with excitement after finding something cute, and of course all your photos! 💖 
To celebrate TOEM's one year anniversary, we're announcing something we've been working on for a while...🥳

The free content update (part 2/2) and the end of our BIG update for the game!
[previewyoutube=O7N8mO84A6s;full][/previewyoutube]

[hr][/hr]

So what is Basto?
Basto is TOEM's biggest region filled with brand new content like treasure hunting, minigames, and spooky stories!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/756ced2d691361363057f8b997ba8c2043b8463b.png
(Left to right) Treasure hunting, the carnival, and spooky stories around a campfire.


How to get to Basto? 🎫
To unlock the Basto region, complete the base game and visit Nana back home in Homelanda!
This update is, of course, FREE!! And it's all thanks to everyone who bought the game and supported us, thank you! 💖


1-2 hours of new content  ⏰
As any other region, there is more things to explore and photograph! And for most players this new region will take about 1-2 hours to 100%, so it should give you plenty of more TOEM to experience!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/12b1e3d8b09428058db263c343b167bfbd3e9f3c.gif
The island of Basto has its own special behavior, which you need to find out on your own! 🛏️


A New Camera Attachment  🎈
With the new water popper you can interact with the world of TOEM in a whole new way, splash your way into stamps and new adventures! It's also kinda funny looking!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/bfd385fd8d7033297e725ccfd30f6d5599807a3e.png
Inside your camera, a new button will appear once you get the water popper, giving you the option to swap between launching water balloons and honking.


6 Music Tracks  💿
Jamal Green & Launchable Socks have knocked out some more bangers for TOEM! They're so amazing at what they do, and we couldn't be happier about having their music in TOEM!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/11372211e24c6771373222e446e9f7f16c718b71.png
More music for your experience at Basto! As always you'll get the cassettes when unlocking new tracks so you can make your own playlist while playing!


20 Compendium Critters  🐌
Looking for funny, cute, and interesting critters is a favorite of many, that's why we added as many new compendium entries as we could!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/c2ca06584abc66070ad7a29e34f868a2e483e5b4.gif
Some of the new critters are not in plain sight and will take some time figuring out how to find!


20 More Quests  ⭐
Ideas that we didn't have time to do in the base game as well as new ones, all found their way to Basto! And we hope you will have a fun time checking out what we've been up to!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/a4a50bee62bdfee20955067275b0debd96881788.gif
Sometimes all you need is some ice cream!


Bug fixes 🐛
New bugs have been made, then resolved, causing old ones to appear, that we then fixed! We think!


[hr][/hr]
We sincerely hope you enjoy this update and all its changes.
We’re eagerly awaiting your reactions on social media, the forums, or Discord!

Hugs and kisses, 💋
TOEM Development Team

notes.title: 2.0.4 Patch
notes.notes:
Gooooood morning!
It's another sunny day in Karlshamn and another patch for TOEM is out!

Here's a short rundown of what we've done with the game this time!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/a11469c3443530d8f4dc69706f8726dfcb57af61.png

New language - Turkish! 📖
New Item - Award mask! 🏆
Because TOEM won the BAFTA Debut Game category we added a celebratory item resembling the trophy that you can wear! (Don't worry, it's not required for the cosplayer achievement!)
New option - 120fps setting is now available. 🎥


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/dafeadd5459bd5ba25cd9abea11ea7054f5f1d48.png

MacOS - Not being able to take photos... In a photo game. 😳
Some older Macs seem to still have this issue and there doesn't seem to be a way to fix it. 😢
MacOS - The screen turns fully magenta for a few frames while opening the camera.
MacOS - Softlocks when trying to load into the game due to errors during loading of photos.
Start a new game - Softlock if attempting to restart a new game if the current game has no photos taken.
Localized - "Show Achievement Prompts" option is now localized again!
Community Card - If your sight photos are missing from your save file, the game won't load and empty frame and soft-lock when you try to inspect it.
Camera frame tutorial always appears when starting the game.
Memory leak - Small leak was found when swapping photos in a picture frame.
Quit - Could not press "Quit" inside the title screen if no game had been started. lol.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/db650cde0fd6f4f56915a64ebe34c7bcba2814dd.png

MacOS - Uses faster scripting backend (IL2CPP) which results in the game running faster!
AntiAliasing - We removed the old AA since it only affected very small parts of the world, the updated options are None, FXAA, and SMAA. (SMAA being the coolest one.)
Options menu - Re-organized some settings.
Preformance - Removed some unnecessary graphics calculations, TOEM should run a little faster now!
Gyro - Both inspecting a photo and the map is affected by gyro now!
Loading screen information when starting the game!

notes.title: Quality Of Life Release
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/b0bba611cf41b8709dda23812fbc53bd447bb83a.png
Quality of Life Update!
It’s time to release all the Quality of Life upgrades we have added to TOEM! 
Just a reminder that this is part 1/2 of our big update. 👀

[hr][/hr]
The first time playing after downloading the patch, all your photos will be updated with our new compression and it can take a moment to process up to 128 photos! ♻️

Frames & Filters 🖼️
You now have plenty of frames and filter to play around with when taking photos!
Just visit the Photo Guild in Stanhamn and talk to the new member for your free upgrade!

We’re super excited to see what kind of crazy photos you can take! 📸

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/3feeaeecbc4752b7fa6cf8fdc7afde21b7a14dcf.gif


Re-stamping ⭐
Finishing a quest and getting a stamp sure feels great, and now you can re-stamp your card as many times as you want! Say goodbye to unsymmetrical stamp placements!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/d5fd6ba7d0ef3cac71beba4f78907bed83783b9b.gif
In the community card there is now a new button in the top left, pressing it will lift your stamps of the card and allows you to place them again.


Liking/Favoriting Pictures 💖
Make your favorite picture stand out even more with the new and lovely shiny foil effect added to pictures you like!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/40197fc4d326633ef933740fa6418dbe7e6af189.gif
Select your pictures in the album, press the like button and watch that shine! 💖


Photo Quest Information 💬
Trying to remember what kind of photo a NPC wanted can sometimes be hard and that’s why this one is such a welcomed addition!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/fc8de9ae510569aa9481f106a17d26a4e59fe656.gif
A box with the relevant quest information can be opened & closed when asked to hand in a photo quest. No more need to exit the dialogue and open the community card just to refresh your memory. All compact and nice now!


Improved Compendium Detection 🐌
Taking a photo of certain compendium critters was sometimes a bit too hard, getting the perfect angle or framing is now easier!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/5f2639b4e5bcc9b69ba87782b6d4142d09196345.png
In the old method, the camera only detected a compendium when the center of the screen was inside the indicator box. But now it checks if the circle is touching any part of the indicator box!


Keyboard support ⌨️
There are many ways to play TOEM... and now there’s even more! Moving with WASD works the same as any controller and is a very natural addition to playing with a mouse.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/a1a795696ccf39dc35da8d98959935138c466ded.gif
Unfortunately, because of our UI system, only certain menus have full support for keyboard. So you will still have to use the mouse for some things! 🙇


New languages 📖
Feeling comfortable when playing TOEM is important to us and we hope that more people will feel at home playing in their native languages. With that said, we have added these additional languages:

[noparse]Brazilian Portuguese [pt-BR][/noparse]
[noparse]Korean [ko][/noparse]
[noparse]Traditional Chinese [zh-TW][/noparse]
[noparse]Swedish [sv][/noparse]

Save File Size Improvements 💾
Saving a photo takes up quite a lot of memory and was a main reason why we had a limit to the amount of photos you could take. But with this updated comes something that is super cool! We managed to reduce the file sizes by over a whooping 🥁 1000% This is not a joke!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/bbd79e351212448c9a92e402d4aea531cd4b3e7a.png
As noted at the top, when starting the first time all your existing photos will be updated and it might take a moment to process up to 128 photos! ♻️

Miscellaneous additions
Doubled Album Capacity
With the changes to the save size we have now doubled the amount of photos you can take to 256 photos!

Steam Cloud Save
Fitting right in with the smaller save size is the Steam cloud save working its ✨magic✨! Keeping your save synced across devices!

Gamepad UI Icons
The game now detects which controller you’re using and will change the UI buttons to the correct one. So if you’re playing with a PlayStation controller the UI will have PlayStation buttons!

Gyro
If you have a PS5 controller you can now enjoy the new gyro feature when using the camera!
Looking around has never felt more natural! In our [strike]biased[/strike] humble opinion, it feels awesome!

Additional Options
Along with the new languages you can also find several new settings to tweak your experience, as well as more details about certain options.

 Auto save delay
 Music trigger delay
 Confined mouse
 Camera sensitivity 
 etc.

Bug fixes 🐛
We’ve also been working hard on fixing bugs, like, at least 4.
Just take our word for it 😎

Major optimizations when using the camera
If you’re playing on a low-end device or a laptop, this update will be very welcomed!! 🙂 

[hr][/hr]
We sincerely hope you enjoy this update and all its changes.
We’re eagerly awaiting your response on social media, the forums, or simply on Discord!

XOXO,
TOEM Development Team

notes.title: TOEM's big update part 1/2 beta test!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/f1aacd1e9a4919140e404d20da19f4007993758e.png

The Quality of Life changes and features we've been working on in part 1/2 of the big update to TOEM are getting near completion and we want to let you try it out before it goes live and hear what you think about it!

Beta access code:
GamesAreCool

⭐ We are very interested in hearing what everyone thinks and feels about all the new changes! ⭐ 

Some specific things we would love to get your feedback on are:
🖼️  The new photo filters! Which is your favourite? Talk to the new npc inside the Photo Guild's house in 'Harbor'.
⌨️  The ability to play with keyboard! Are there any features missing or unnecessary?
🎮  PS5 controller gyro functionality! Let us know how it feels and fits into the game.
🐞  The camera has gotten an upgrade when detecting compendium items, can you feel the difference?
🔁 Restamp your community card to your hearts desire!
---------------------------------------------
🛠️  Press F1 to open our dev menu.

❗ Stay safe while exploring the new features! ❗
Since we have done a major overhaul of our save system it would be wise to go into your save folder and make a copy in the unlikely event that something break!

How to find your save folder:
1. Press the 'Windows' key + 'R'.
2. Type in 'Appdata' and hit 'OK'.
3. Click on the folders: LocalLow -> Something We Made -> TOEM and then there should be a folder named Save.
4. Copy the folder somewhere for safe keeping!
Bam! You're all set!

How to access the beta branch: 
1. Right-click TOEM on Steam and click 'Properties...'
2. In the window that opens, go into 'BETAS' found on the top left side
3. Enter the code GamesAreCool and press 'Check Code'
4. Press the big blue button that shows up below.
And that's it! Your Steam should now automatically download the new build! 


Join us on discord!

notes.title: Big Update Announcement - Part 1/2
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/dbd17573449606925bfcaba5953125d907aef99b.png
It's finally time for us to reveal what's next

TOEM is getting an update... A BIG ONE! 
It's even split into two parts 

Part #1 is focused on Quality of Life update and is coming Q1 2022. It’s meant to improve your playing experience and for that to happen we need your input on what’s missing!

How can you help?
Simply comment on this post!! It can be whatever, a language, a feature, as long as you think it’s missing we’ll look into it!

Here’s what we have planned
PC

 Cloud save
 Button Remapping (HOPEFULLY!!)
 Keyboard compatibility (movement, interaction, etc)

Console

 PS5 haptic feedback + adaptive triggers
 Switch HD Rumble (improved vibrations)

New Settings

 Photomode steering sensitivity
 Reset all options to default
 Ambience music silence duration (How long it will be silent until the next song plays)
 Autosave interval
 Camera blur quality setting (Not on Switch)

Gameplay

 Increased photo capacity for all platforms
 Gyroscope support (PS5, Switch, and certain PC controllers)
 Ability to start a new game without resetting all in-game achievements
 Ability to re-place stamps inside the community card
 Kinder compendium creature detection
 Making more items usable from the inventory like opening the camera or placing the tripod
 Major performance increases across the whole game, most when using the photo mode camera
 Help prompt/menu when showing an NPC a photo for a quest

----------------------------------------------------------

Thanks for reading through it all, we hope you like what we have planned for this patch.

We’re eagerly awaiting your input!!!

❗️We are accepting input until 31th of January 2022❗️

notes.title: "Help! I can't move!" hotfix!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

This small 6MB hotfixes to the game's navigation and a "Help! I can't move!" button inside the pause menu for those situations where you're really stuck inside things.

That said, we've noticed some issues like players getting stuck, soft-locking while talking to certain NPCs. We have taken notes and while fixing it in the coming week!

We're so happy seeing everyone streaming, sharing photos, and most importantly, having a good time while playing TOEM!

ALSO PLEASE LEAVE YOUR HONEST STEAM REVIEW! We want to hear what you think about TOEM ^^

-------------

### Added
- "Help! I can't move" button inside the Pause Menu
- Toggleable UI by pressing F2 F3, or F4 (three different levels of hiding with F4 hides everything)

### Fixed
- Certain navigation errors where you could get stuck in the city region
